response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced, versatile senior engineer with 15+ years across web, mobile, embedded and open-source work, but his profile does not match the core requirements of this role. The position demands 8 years of C++ programming and 5 years building large-scale infrastructure or compute/hardware platforms; his C++ exposure is limited to roughly six months at National Instruments (2014-2015) and a university thesis project, with the bulk of his career in TypeScript/Node.js, D and web stacks. He also lacks demonstrated formal technical leadership of a cloud compute platform, though he shows mentoring instincts via workshops, courses and founding an open-source GIS platform. The high-throughput microservices work at Sociomantic and Kubernetes/DevOps exposure are relevant adjacents, but not sufficient to close the gap for a C++-centric internal cloud compute platform lead.
strengths: Deep, broad engineering experience (15+ yrs) with strong testing/TDD and craftsmanship focus
Real distributed-systems exposure: low-latency microservices handling millions of req/s at Sociomantic
Demonstrated mentoring and knowledge-sharing via workshops, courses, talks and founding an OSS platform
concerns: Only ~6 months of professional C++ vs. the 8-year minimum requirement
No production cloud compute platform architecture or hardware/storage/compute technology depth
No formal technical leadership role mentoring cloud/DevOps engineers or owning platform strategy

key_factors.factor: Lack of cloud compute platform / infra-at-scale ownership
Seniority, mentoring track record and distributed-systems adjacency
